description:
Move step records out of the branch worktree to the conv-repo
root. Carries the structural enforcement of the diagnostic-only
rule (P1, ARCH amendment): no harness code path may read
request.json or response.json after this lands.

=== Scope ===

1. Path relocation. step_dir_rel and all writers (write_snapshot,
   write_response, write_tool_records, etc.) target
   <conv-repo>/steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/{request.json, response.json,
   tools/<tool-id>/{input,output}.json}. Worktree no longer
   contains a steps/ tree.

2. Snapshot-commit simplification per amended §2.10:
   - Step 1 dispatch commit: goal.md + soul.md only. No
     request.json in the tree.
   - Step ≥2: no pre-call commit. The branch tip already
     represents the model-read state.
   - response.json is no longer committed at any step.

3. Step record gains a 'commit:' field (string SHA). Writer
   captures the branch tip at step start; readers (frontend,
   diagnostics) use it to locate the tree state the request was
   assembled against.

4. Manifest scope trim. template/manifest.yaml worker.order: drops
   'steps/**/request.json' and 'steps/**/response.json'. Other
   patterns (summary/, descriptions/, skills/, goal.md, soul.md)
   stay — those are real context.

5. Diagnostic-only enforcement. After the relocation, grep the
   workspace for any read of request.json or response.json from
   harness code paths — must return zero hits. Tool input.json /
   output.json reads are explicitly preserved (those have legit
   runtime integration).

6. Test rewrites. Existing tests under src/prompt/, tests/, and
   the dispatch test fixtures point at the new path. Coverage
   stays at 100%.

=== Out of scope ===

- Streaming JSONL response.json shape — that is P3.
- UI watch-path updates — that is P4.

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: v0.3.1 P2: harness step record relocation + snapshot simplification
